title: Lehmer's totient problem and the companion equation phi(n) | n+1: code and data
description: Programs, recorded output and factorisation data for the paper 'Lehmer's totient problem and the companion equation phi(n) | n+1'. The searches prove that composite solutions of phi(n) | n-1 have at least 16 prime factors, classify the solutions of phi(n) | n+1 with at most 7 prime factors, and show that solutions of phi(n) | n+1 prime to 3 have at least 16 prime factors. The last three prime factors are found through divisors of an explicit integer in a residue class, located by counting lattice points near a hyperbola, in two independent implementations.
